post.title: Medicare pays surgery centers less. How one chain earns 39%
post.ig:
Medicare pays surgery centers less. So why is one chain's margin 39%?
Medicare's 2026 base rate per payment unit: $56.32 for a surgery center (ASC) vs $91.42 for a hospital outpatient department.
Tenet's surgery center arm, USPI, had a 39.2% adjusted EBITDA margin in 2025 ($2.026B on $5.172B revenue), vs 15.7% for Tenet's hospitals. Margins cover all payers and include physician partners' share.
Surgery Partners ran 176 facilities at the end of 2025, mostly in partnership with physicians.
Sources: CMS CY2026 OPPS/ASC final rule, Tenet FY2025 results, Surgery Partners FY2025 10-K.
